'''2016 MPC Day 2 Jonny Chu DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
